_read: THE TEMPLATE. Copy this folder into your project, swap the owner, and start writing.
After 00-kinds, the catalogue of what a block can be, the ten sections are the order in which
product documentation usually gets on its feet:
why it exists → who can do what → what it looks like → what the person sees → what is still open →
what it is built from → how the data connects → the flow end to end → the architecture → the edges.
Each page carries, in its own reviewable text, what to write there and what NOT to write.
Delete whatever does not serve you. A template that forces turns into paperwork.
checks/ holds the test that Y01's rule names in data-proof. Run it with: node --test 'checks/*.test.js'
name: Template
_theme: HOW YOUR PROJECT DRESSES THE ENGINE. All three keys are optional; with no theme at all the
engine wears its own neutral look, which is nobody's brand.
brand: the brand colour. Hex only, three or six digits — anything else is refused and logged.
logo:  a path inside this folder (svg, png, webp, jpg, gif, up to 64 KiB). The server reads it
and inlines it; without a logo, the name is shown. Not set here because the template
ships no image, and a broken logo is worse than none.
name:  what the sign-in screen calls the product. Defaults to `name` above.
